item.title: Mamdani, Hochul reveal 1st four NYC communities to get free 2-K seats this fall
item.description: NEW YORK, NEW YORK – FEBRUARY 10: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is joined by New York Governor Kathy Hochul at an event in Brooklyn to support more housing construction in New York City on February 10, 2026 in New York City. Under Hochul’s “Let Them Build” agenda, she and Mamdani have advocated for more housing in New York City, which faces a severe housing shortage and long, expensive regulatory delays before projects can proceed. (Photo by Spencer Platt/Getty Images)
